name: Oh Hell
tagline: Hands grow and shrink each round. Bid exactly right — no more, no less.
rulesSummary: Round 1 deals one card each, then one more each round up to seven, then back down.
The card turned up after the deal sets trumps. Bid exactly how many tricks you'll take.
The dealer bids last and can't make the bids add up to the number of tricks.
Hit your bid exactly for 10 points plus 1 per trick. Miss it and score nothing.
